meta.name: add-tavily-tool
meta.description: Add Tavily Search and Extract as keyless remote MCP tools for selected NanoClaw agent groups. Use when installing Tavily web search or URL extraction without an API key.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加免密钥的搜索与网页提取能力到智能体组
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在用 NanoClaw 管理智能体，希望它们能直接搜索网页和提取内容
copy.tagline_en: Add keyless web search and extraction to your agent groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage NanoClaw agents and want them to search the web without an API key.

howto.what: 为选定的 NanoClaw agent 组安装 mcp-remote 桥接并注册 Tavily 远程 MCP 服务器,使该组多出 tavily_search 和 tavily_extract 两个工具,无需 API key。
howto.when: 当你为 NanoClaw 的 agent 组安装 Tavily 网页搜索或 URL 提取、且不用 API key 时触发。Claude provider 的组已有内置 WebSearch、WebFetch,其他 provider 的组收益更大。

say.text: 给 group my-group 装上 Tavily 搜索和提取
say.note: 会装桥接并注册 keyless 服务器

say.text: 用 Tavily 搜一条,max_results 设为 1
say.note: 用来验证 tavily_search 是否可用

say.text: Tavily 报 429 了,帮我改用 API key
say.note: 走 OneCLI 面板的升级流程

howto.what_en: Installs an mcp-remote bridge and registers Tavily's remote MCP server for selected NanoClaw agent groups, exposing tavily_search and tavily_extract with no API key.
howto.when_en: Use when installing Tavily web search or URL extraction for a NanoClaw agent group without an API key. Groups on the Claude provider already have built-in WebSearch and WebFetch.

say_en.text: Add Tavily search and extract to group my-group
say_en.note: Installs the bridge and registers the keyless server

say_en.text: Run one Tavily search with max_results 1
Tavily returned 429 — switch me to an API key
say_en.note: Starts the OneCLI dashboard upgrade path
